blocks.text: Zeinab Harake and Bobby Ray Parks Jr. couldn’t contain their joy as her children, Lucas and Bia, are now officially Parks following the completion of their legal adoption process. The couple shared the milestone through her YouTube vlog on Wednesday, Nov. 4, recalling how they started the adoption process even before they got married in June 2025. “Legally, Parks na kaming tatlo,” Harake said. “Lagi kong sinasabi sa mga vlog and interviews ko na kung may pangarap ako sa buhay ko ngayon, hindi na materyal… Ang goal ko talaga is magkaroon kami ng birth certificate na pare-parehas kami ng apelyido,” she […]...
